answer: Mechanism: congestion-priced entropy leases. Each new agent identity must draw one plume from a domain’s entropy pool; the plume price follows P(n)=P0·e^{αn} in active identities, paid continuously. Renewal requires a juniper stamp, while useful work mints quill credits that offset lease costs. An attacker creating N sybils pays the integral of P(n) over N plus N recurring stamps—superlinear in N—while honest agents amortize via quill. No hard cap; marginal cost alone deters.
